remarks: Welcome to Silvermine Riverfront! Your dream condo is ready and waiting for you. Imagine starting your day with a cup of coffee on your private balcony, or hosting friends for a delightful dinner in your pristine white kitchen. This kitchen boasts granite countertops and stainless steel appliances, including a full-sized dishwasher, ensuring both style and convenience. The breakfast bar opens up to the dining area and living room, creating a seamless, inviting space perfect for entertaining. Your primary bedroom is a haven of comfort with ample closet space and an ensuite bath. For your guests' convenience, there's also a powder room. Laundry is hassle-free with a stackable washer and dryer right in the unit. The condo is freshly painted, featuring re-finished hardwood floors and elegant crown mouldings throughout. Extra storage space is available in the basement, and you'll have your own assigned parking spot, plus plenty of visitor spaces. The location couldn't be more ideal-just minutes from I-95, Merritt Parkway, trains, and public transportation. Plus, shopping and restaurants are within walking distance. Welcome home!
